about.en: Broccoli is a BNB Chain memecoin named after Changpeng Zhao's dog, deployed at 0x12B4356C65340Fb02cdff01293F95FEBb1512F3b and promoted as the first Broccoli token (firstbroccoli.com). Because several unrelated Broccoli tokens launched at the same time, exchanges list this one as BROCCOLIF3B after the end of its contract address; it is not the CZ's Dog token listed as BROCCOLI714.
